text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if galvanized to action by Silence
Suzuka's
otherworldly speed...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Younger runners have also been pulling
far ahead
in this new age of speed-first
racing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka! Here I cooooome!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yesss! Mom! Mama! I hope you were
watching!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week, the roommate of Silence
Suzuka, is
one of them. She dominated
the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We arrive at the Takarazuka Kinen. For
various reasons, Mejiro Bright and I
decided it would be
best not to run in it,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, Dober! Keep up the pace!
Suzuka
may be in front, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh... her speed... it's not dropping at
all...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just keep going!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka has pulled far, far away!
What
incredible speed! No one can even
come close!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's really from another world! Whether
it's a G1
or a G2 makes no difference!
Look at her go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka's victory is absolute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is unable to catch up, and
Mejiro Bright is momentarily at a loss for
words, having
witnessed Silence Suzuka's
speed, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Suzuka. You were
spectacular
out there.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Have I seen anyone run like that ever
before?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe I have... That was
something I... it
was something no Mejiro
is capable of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So that was the real you, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It was, Bright... And it was thanks to you
that I'm
able to run like this, like myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huh? M-me?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Back at the Derby, you ran in a way
only you
could.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's when I decided I wanted to run in a way only I can.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The Suzuka who raced against you then
was not
me. But today... I am my real
self.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
However,
I'm still not perfect. I still can't
reach
that scenery...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But, at the autumn Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then that means I shall also have
to polish
myself to a brighter sheen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Just like how the scenery you seek
remains out of
reach...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro's ideal still lies beyond me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, Suzuka, would you do me
the honor
of racing against me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Before, I may have inspired you. But
today, you
were the one who taught me
something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm not done yet. I can still run in a way
that is
more fitting to the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So... at the autumn Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both inspired by the other, and
awakened to their
potential, they
promise to meet again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho. I feel like
something special will happen after what
I've seen here today. To be at our best,
we'll have to train like
never before.
